notes: Thresholds fitted from ideal_1 vs ideal_2 variation across training transcript groups using DTW alignment. Each threshold set as mean + k*SD of the ideal-vs-ideal feature distribution. No test data accessed during calibration. Config frozen in configs/pipeline.json. Previous version (0.927 accuracy claim) used hardcoded thresholds — this has been corrected.
what_we_found: Previous calibrate_pipeline.py wrote hardcoded thresholds without fitting. The 0.927 accuracy figure was not traceable to the script output. This has been fixed: thresholds are now derived from ideal-vs-ideal acoustic variation on the training set.
